notes:
Bitify 1.7.6 for Windows

The app carries the product's name now, all the way down: the package is com.bitify.music on the phone, the party links say bitify:// instead of the old name, and the server calls itself bitify-listen-together. A link shared before the rename still opens the app.

Also in this release:
- The Diwali greeting no longer sits on top of the update dialog. An update on offer now waits for the greeting to be put away, so the Download button is really the button you press - before this, the tap meant for Download landed on the greeting and nothing was ever downloaded.
- The listening minutes, the streak and the leaderboard keep working the way they did: they live with your account, the server keeps them in the database instead of on a disk that a release wipes, and one listener is one row on the board.
- The privacy policy, the terms and the security page now write to you directly.
